when.test: searchCategory != null and searchCategory == '소분류' and searchKeyword != null and searchKeyword != ''

choose.when: SELECT DISTINCT c.code_id, c.code_id_nm, c.code_id_dc AS codeDc, c.use_yn, c.register_id, TO_CHAR(c.regist_dt, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS registDt FROM tb_cmmn_code c INNER JOIN tb_cmmn_code_detail cd ON c.code_id = cd.code_id WHERE 1=1 AND UPPER(cd.code_nm) LIKE UPPER(CONCAT('%', #{searchKeyword}, '%')) ORDER BY c.code_id
choose.otherwise:
SELECT code_id, code_id_nm, code_id_dc AS codeDc, use_yn, register_id, TO_CHAR(regist_dt, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS registDt FROM tb_cmmn_code WHERE 1=1
AND UPPER(code_id_nm) LIKE UPPER(CONCAT('%', #{searchKeyword}, '%'))
ORDER BY code_id

mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tb_cmmn_code ( code_id, code_id_nm, code_id_dc, use_yn, register_id, regist_dt ) VALUES ( #{codeId}, #{codeIdNm}, #{codeDc, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, COALESCE(#{useYn}, 'Y'), #{registerId}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP )
mapper.select: SELECT code_id, code, code_nm, code_dc, code_order, use_yn, register_id, TO_CHAR(regist_dt, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS registDt FROM tb_cmmn_code_detail WHERE code_id = #{codeId} ORDER BY code_order, code
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tb_cmmn_code_detail ( code_id, code, code_nm, code_dc, code_order, use_yn, register_id, regist_dt ) VALUES ( #{codeId}, #{code}, #{codeNm}, #{codeDc, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, COALESCE(#{codeOrder}, 0), COALESCE(#{useYn}, 'Y'), #{registerId}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP )
